## Updated `autoinstall.bat` file

<details>
  <summary>updated autoinstall.bat</summary>
  <br>

```batch
@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion

REM ============================================
REM Enhanced Batch Script with Chocolatey Install
REM ============================================

REM Define pause duration for message readability
set "PAUSE_DURATION=3"

REM Function to pause
:pauseForReadability
timeout /t %PAUSE_DURATION% >nul
exit /b

REM Function to display messages with color
:printMsg
set "type=%~1"
set "text=%~2"
if /I "%type%"=="info" echo [i] %text%
if /I "%type%"=="success" echo [Success] %text%
if /I "%type%"=="warning" echo [!] %text%
if /I "%type%"=="error" echo [x] %text%
exit /b

REM Step 1: Check for Chocolatey, and install if missing
call :printMsg info "Checking if Chocolatey is installed..."
choco -? >nul 2>&1
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
    call :printMsg warning "Chocolatey is not installed. Installing Chocolatey via PowerShell..."
    powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ^
        "Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process; ^
         [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [System.Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; ^
         Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1 -UseBasicParsing | Invoke-Expression"
    
    if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
        call :printMsg error "Failed to install Chocolatey. Please check your internet connection or run the command manually."
        exit /b
    ) else (
        call :printMsg success "Chocolatey installed successfully."
    )
) else (
    call :printMsg success "Chocolatey is already installed."
)
call :pauseForReadability

REM Step 2: Check for Java installation (Version 8-21)
call :printMsg info "Checking for any Java version between 8 and 21..."
for /f "tokens=2 delims=[]" %%v in ('java -version 2>&1') do set "JAVA_VERSION=%%v"
set "JAVA_VERSION_MAJOR="
for /f "tokens=2 delims=. " %%v in ("%JAVA_VERSION%") do set "JAVA_VERSION_MAJOR=%%v"

if defined JAVA_VERSION_MAJOR (
    if %JAVA_VERSION_MAJOR% geq 8 if %JAVA_VERSION_MAJOR% leq 21 (
        call :printMsg success "Java version %JAVA_VERSION_MAJOR% is installed."
    ) else (
        call :printMsg warning "Java version is not within the range of 8-21. Installing OpenJDK 17..."
        choco install -y openjdk17
    )
) else (
    call :printMsg warning "Java is not installed. Installing OpenJDK 17..."
    choco install -y openjdk17
)
call :pauseForReadability

REM Step 3: Check for Node.js installation
call :printMsg info "Checking if Node.js is installed..."
where node >nul 2>&1
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
    call :printMsg warning "Node.js is not installed. Installing Node.js and npm..."
    choco install -y nodejs
) else (
    call :printMsg success "Node.js is installed."
)
call :pauseForReadability

REM Step 4: Check for npm installation
call :printMsg info "Checking if npm is installed..."
where npm >nul 2>&1
if %errorlevel% neq 0 (
    call :printMsg warning "npm is not installed. Installing npm..."
    choco install -y npm
) else (
    call :printMsg success "npm is installed."
)
call :pauseForReadability

REM Script Completed
call :printMsg success "All checks and installations are complete."
exit /b
```

## Automatic application Wi-Fi IP Address (macOS and Linux support added with IPv6 and IPv4 support)

<details>
  <summary>Auto Wifi IP application (win32, linux, darwin)</summary>
<br>
  
```javascript
const os = require('os'); // Ensure you have the 'os' module imported

// Function to get Wi-Fi IP address (both IPv4 and IPv6)
function getWiFiIP() {
    const networkInterfaces = os.networkInterfaces();
    for (let interfaceName in networkInterfaces) {
        if (interfaceName.toLowerCase().includes('wi-fi')) { // Specifically look for 'Wi-Fi'
            for (let iface of networkInterfaces[interfaceName]) {
                if (!iface.internal) { // Ignore internal interfaces
                    if (iface.family === 'IPv4') {
                        return { ip: iface.address, type: 'IPv4' }; // Return IPv4 address
                    } else if (iface.family === 'IPv6') {
                        return { ip: iface.address, type: 'IPv6' }; // Return IPv6 address
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    // If no IP address is found, return null to indicate failure
    return null;
}

// Function to Automatically set the IP address
$appCtrl.setWiFiIP = () => {
    const wifiInfo = getWiFiIP(); // Call the function to get Wi-Fi IP address
    if (wifiInfo) {
        $appCtrl.srcIP = wifiInfo.ip; // Set the IP address in the AngularJS model
        console.log(`Using ${wifiInfo.type} address: ${wifiInfo.ip}`); // Log the type of IP address used
    } else {
        // Log a warning message if the IP address cannot be set
        $appCtrl.Log('[!] Unable to Automatically Apply Your Private Wireless LAN adapter Wi-Fi address.', CONSTANTS.logStatus.WARNING);
        $appCtrl.Log('[¡] Please Enter it Manually.',  CONSTANTS.logStatus.INFO);
    }
};

// Detect tab click event and then call the function to set the Wi-Fi IP address
$(document).ready(function () {
    $('a.item').click(function () {
        const tab = $(this).attr('data-tab');
        if (tab === 'second') { // APK Builder tab
            $appCtrl.setWiFiIP(); // Set the IP when the APK Builder tab is clicked
            $appCtrl.$apply(); // Update the AngularJS scope manually
        }
    });
});
```

## Updated Launch/Activity based Search and Extract logic
> These updates should handle the common edge cases involved in locating the main launcher activity class in Android manifest files. This logic is focused on discovering a concrete launchable class for smali hooking, not on validating every possible manifest configuration. See "potentially handled edge cases" for more info.

<details>
<summary>Potentially Handled Edge Cases</summary>
<br>

1. Missing or Invalid <application> Tag

  - Checks that the <application> tag exists.

  - Logs an error and returns null if it is missing.

2. Missing Package Name in <manifest>

  - Verifies that the root <manifest> element contains a package attribute.

  - Logs an error and returns null if the package name is absent.

3. Disabled Application

  - Checks whether <application android:enabled="false"> is set.

  - If the application is disabled, logs an error and returns null, since no launcher components will be considered launchable.

4. Launcher Activities in <activity> Nodes

  - Filters out activities explicitly disabled via android:enabled="false".

  - Filters out activities that are not exported.

  - Considers only activities that contain at least one <intent-filter> with both:

    - android.intent.action.MAIN

    - android.intent.category.LAUNCHER

  - Normalizes relative activity names such as .MainActivity into fully-qualified names using the app package name.

  - Excludes system classes using known package prefixes.

  - Deduplicates repeated fully-qualified activity names.

5. Launcher Activities via <activity-alias> Nodes

  - Filters out aliases explicitly disabled via android:enabled="false".

  - Filters out aliases that are not exported.

  - Considers only aliases that contain at least one <intent-filter> with both:

    - android.intent.action.MAIN

    - android.intent.category.LAUNCHER

  - Extracts and validates the android:targetActivity attribute.

  - Normalizes relative target names into fully-qualified class names.

  - Excludes system classes using known package prefixes.

  - Deduplicates by normalized target activity name so the same hook target is not returned more than once.

6. Multiple Launcher Candidates

  - Collects all valid launcher candidates from both <activity> and <activity-alias> nodes.

  - Uses the highest android:priority value found in any intent-filter as the primary sort key.

  - Uses manifest declaration order as the tie-breaker when priorities are equal.

  - Logs when multiple launcher entries are found and reports the selected candidate.

7. Final Hook Target Resolution

  - Converts the selected fully-qualified class name into a smali-relative path.

  - Returns the smali path for the chosen launcher target along with a type of "launcher".

8. Fallback Handling When Nothing Is Found

  - Logs an error and returns null if no valid launcher activity or alias is identified.

</details>
<details>
<summary>Code</summary>
<br>

```js
// Android namespace used by android:* attributes in AndroidManifest.xml
const ANDROID_NS = 'http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android';

// Namespace-aware XPath helper.
// xpath supports mapped prefixes via useNamespaces(...).
const select = xpath.useNamespaces({
    android: ANDROID_NS
});

/**
 * Converts a fully-qualified class name into its smali file path,
 * preserving package structure (e.g. com/example/app/MainActivity.smali).
 * Note: does not know which smali_classesN/ multidex root the class lives in —
 * downstream lookup should try this relative path against each root in turn.
 *
 * @param {string} fullyQualifiedName - The fully-qualified class name.
 * @returns {string|null} - The smali-relative path, or null if empty.
 */
function classNameToSmaliPath(fullyQualifiedName) {
    if (!fullyQualifiedName) return null;
    return `${fullyQualifiedName.replace(/\./g, '/')}.smali`;
}

/**
 * Resolves a possibly-relative class name (".MainActivity") to fully-qualified
 * form (com.example.app.MainActivity) using the package name. Fully-qualified
 * names are returned unchanged.
 *
 * @param {string} name - The class name to normalize.
 * @param {string} packageName - The app's package name.
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
function normalizeClassName(name, packageName) {
    if (!name) return name;
    return name.startsWith('.') ? `${packageName}${name}` : name;
}

/**
 * Checks if the class is a system class (like `android.app` or `androidx`).
 *
 * @param {string} className - The class name to check.
 * @returns {boolean} - Whether the class name is a system class.
 */
const systemClassPrefixes = [
    'android.app',
    'androidx',
    'android.support',
    'android.view',
    'android.content'
];

function isSystemClass(className) {
    return systemClassPrefixes.some(prefix => className.startsWith(prefix));
}

/**
 * Reads an attribute from an xmldom node.
 *
 * @param {Node} node
 * @param {string} attrName
 * @returns {string|null}
 */
function getAttr(node, attrName) {
    if (!node || typeof node.getAttribute !== 'function') return null;
    const value = node.getAttribute(attrName);
    return value == null ? null : String(value);
}

/**
 * Checks if an element (application, activity, or alias) is enabled.
 *
 * @param {Node} element - The XML element to check.
 * @returns {boolean} - True if enabled or not explicitly disabled.
 */
function isEnabled(element) {
    return getAttr(element, 'android:enabled') !== 'false';
}

/**
 * Checks if an activity or alias is exported.
 *
 * @param {Node} element - The XML element to check.
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
function isExported(element) {
    return getAttr(element, 'android:exported') !== 'false';
}

/**
 * Checks if an intent-filter has the MAIN action and LAUNCHER category.
 *
 * @param {Node} filter - The intent-filter node to check.
 * @returns {boolean}
 */
function isLauncherActivityFilter(filter) {
    const actions = select('./action', filter);
    const categories = select('./category', filter);

    const hasMain = actions.some(action =>
        getAttr(action, 'android:name') === 'android.intent.action.MAIN'
    );

    const hasLauncher = categories.some(category =>
        getAttr(category, 'android:name') === 'android.intent.category.LAUNCHER'
    );

    return hasMain && hasLauncher;
}

/**
 * Returns the highest priority among all intent-filters of an activity or alias.
 *
 * @param {Node} element - The activity or alias element.
 * @returns {number} - Highest priority value, or 0 if missing/invalid.
 */
function getHighestPriority(element) {
    const filters = select('./intent-filter', element);
    if (!Array.isArray(filters) || filters.length === 0) return 0;

    return filters.reduce((max, filter) => {
        const parsed = parseInt(getAttr(filter, 'android:priority') ?? '0', 10);
        const priority = Number.isNaN(parsed) ? 0 : parsed;
        return Math.max(max, priority);
    }, 0);
}

/**
 * Parses manifest XML into an xmldom Document.
 *
 * @param {string} manifestXml
 * @returns {Document|null}
 */
function parseManifestXml(manifestXml) {
    if (typeof manifestXml !== 'string' || !manifestXml.trim()) return null;
    return new DOMParser().parseFromString(manifestXml, 'application/xml');
}

/**
 * Serializes an xmldom Document back to XML.
 *
 * @param {Document} doc
 * @returns {string}
 */
function serializeManifestXml(doc) {
    if (!doc) return '';
    return new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(doc);
}

/**
 * Locates the main launcher activity in an Android manifest, whether declared
 * as a plain <activity> or via <activity-alias>, handling multiple candidates.
 *
 * @param {Document|string} manifestInput - Parsed xmldom Document or raw XML string.
 * @returns {object|null} - { className: <smali-relative path>, type: 'launcher' }, or null if not found.
 */
function getLauncherActivity(manifestInput) {
    delayedLog('[★] Attempting to Locate the Main Launcher Activity Class...');

    const manifestDoc =
        typeof manifestInput === 'string'
            ? parseManifestXml(manifestInput)
            : manifestInput;

    if (!manifestDoc) {
        delayedLog('[!] Failed to parse AndroidManifest.xml.', CONSTANTS.logStatus.ERROR);
        return null;
    }

    const manifestNode = select('/manifest', manifestDoc)[0];
    const application = select('/manifest/application', manifestDoc)[0];

    if (!application) {
        delayedLog('[!] No <application> tag found in manifest.', CONSTANTS.logStatus.ERROR);
        return null;
    }

    const packageName = getAttr(manifestNode, 'package');
    if (!packageName) {
        delayedLog('[!] No package name found in manifest. Invalid manifest.', CONSTANTS.logStatus.ERROR);
        return null;
    }

    if (!isEnabled(application)) {
        delayedLog('[!] <application> itself is disabled. No components are launchable.', CONSTANTS.logStatus.ERROR);
        return null;
    }

    const activities = select('/manifest/application/activity', manifestDoc);
    const activityAliases = select('/manifest/application/activity-alias', manifestDoc);

    // Unified candidate pool: { className, priority, order, source }
    const candidates = [];
    const seen = new Set(); // dedupe by normalized (fully-qualified) className
    let order = 0;

    // Pass 1: direct <activity> declarations
    for (const activity of activities) {
        order++;

        if (!isEnabled(activity)) continue;
        if (!isExported(activity)) continue;

        const intentFilters = select('./intent-filter', activity);
        if (!Array.isArray(intentFilters) || !intentFilters.some(isLauncherActivityFilter)) {
            continue;
        }

        const rawClassName = getAttr(activity, 'android:name');
        const normalizedClassName = normalizeClassName(rawClassName, packageName);

        if (!normalizedClassName || isSystemClass(normalizedClassName)) continue;
        if (seen.has(normalizedClassName)) continue;
        seen.add(normalizedClassName);

        candidates.push({
            className: normalizedClassName,
            priority: getHighestPriority(activity),
            order,
            source: 'activity'
        });
    }

    // Pass 2: <activity-alias> declarations, resolved to their target.
    // The alias is judged on its own enabled/exported/intent-filter state.
    for (const alias of activityAliases) {
        order++;

        if (!isEnabled(alias)) continue;
        if (!isExported(alias)) continue;

        const intentFilters = select('./intent-filter', alias);
        if (!Array.isArray(intentFilters) || !intentFilters.some(isLauncherActivityFilter)) {
            continue;
        }

        const rawTargetName = getAttr(alias, 'android:targetActivity');
        if (!rawTargetName || rawTargetName.trim() === '') {
            delayedLog('[!] Invalid or missing targetActivity in alias.', CONSTANTS.logStatus.WARNING);
            continue;
        }

        const normalizedTargetName = normalizeClassName(rawTargetName, packageName);

        if (isSystemClass(normalizedTargetName)) continue;
        if (seen.has(normalizedTargetName)) continue;
        seen.add(normalizedTargetName);

        candidates.push({
            className: normalizedTargetName,
            priority: getHighestPriority(alias),
            order,
            source: 'alias'
        });
    }

    if (candidates.length === 0) {
        delayedLog('[!] No Main Launcher Activity Class Found (activities or aliases).', CONSTANTS.logStatus.ERROR);
        return null;
    }

    // Rank: highest priority wins; ties broken by manifest declaration order.
    candidates.sort((a, b) => b.priority - a.priority || a.order - b.order);

    const chosen = candidates[0];
    const smaliPath = classNameToSmaliPath(chosen.className);
    const chosenSimpleName = chosen.className.split('.').pop();

    if (candidates.length > 1) {
        const runnerUp = candidates[1];
        const reason = chosen.priority > runnerUp.priority
            ? `Highest priority (${chosen.priority})`
            : 'First declaration (priority tie)';

        delayedLog(
            `[i] Found ${candidates.length} launcher entries.\n\n` +
            `Selecting:\n${chosenSimpleName}\n\n` +
            `Reason:\n${reason}`,
            CONSTANTS.logStatus.INFO
        );
    }

    delayedLog(
        `[¡] Scoped the Main Launcher Activity Class for Hooking (${chosen.source}): ${smaliPath}`,
        CONSTANTS.logStatus.INFO
    );

    return { className: smaliPath, type: 'launcher' };
}

/**
 * Resolves a launcher activity's smali file to its actual path on disk by
 * checking each multidex smali root (smali, smali_classes2, smali_classes3, ...).
 *
 * @param {object} launcherActivity - { className: <relative smali path>, type }
 * @param {string} apkFolder - Root of the decompiled APK.
 * @param {function} callback - (err, launcherPath)
 */
function getLauncherPath(launcherActivity, apkFolder, callback) {
    if (!launcherActivity || !launcherActivity.className) {
        return callback('[x] No launcher activity className provided.');
    }

    const relativePath = launcherActivity.className; // e.g. com/example/app/MainActivity.smali

    fs.readdir(apkFolder, (err, entries) => {
        if (err) return callback(err);

        const smaliRoots = entries.filter(e => /^smali(_classes\d+)?$/.test(e));
        if (smaliRoots.length === 0) {
            return callback('[x] No smali directories found in APK folder.');
        }

        const tryRoot = (i) => {
            if (i >= smaliRoots.length) {
                return callback('[x] Unable to Locate the Hookable Main Class File!');
            }

            const candidatePath = dir.join(apkFolder, smaliRoots[i], relativePath);

            fs.access(candidatePath, fs.constants.F_OK, (accessErr) => {
                if (!accessErr) {
                    return callback(null, candidatePath);
                }

                tryRoot(i + 1);
            });
        };

        tryRoot(0);
    });
}
```
